\section*{Question 2}
\begin{itemize}
\item[] Let \(R\) be the region enclosed by the graph of \(f(x)=x^{4}-2.3 x^{3}+4\) and the horizontal line \(y=4\), as shown in the figure above.
\item[(a)] Find the volume of the solid generated when \(R\) is rotated about the horizontal line \(y=-2\).
\item[(b)] Region \(R\) is the base of a solid. For this solid, each cross section perpendicular to the \(x\)-axis is an isosceles right triangle with a leg in \(R\). Find the volume of the solid.
(c) The vertical line \(x=k\) divides \(R\) into two regions with equal areas. Write, but do not solve, an equation involving integral expressions whose solution gives the value \(k\).
![](https://cdn.mathpix.com/cropped/05b4e906-0a40-4072-b3b5-110a59d2e023-1.jpg?height=539&width=559&top_left_y=400&top_left_x=1371)
\item[(a)] \(f(x)=4 \Rightarrow x=0,2.3\)
\[
\begin{aligned}
\text { Volume } & =\pi \int_{0}^{2.3}\left[(4+2)^{2}-(f(x)+2)^{2}\right] d x \\
& =98.868(\text { or } 98.867)
\end{aligned}
\]
\item[(b)]
\[
\begin{aligned}
\text { Volume } & =\int_{0}^{2.3} \frac{1}{2}(4-f(x))^{2} d x \\
& =3.574(\text { or } 3.573)
\end{aligned}
\]
\item[(c)] \(\int_{0}^{k}(4-f(x)) d x=\int_{k}^{2.3}(4-f(x)) d x\)
\item[4] : \(\left\{\begin{array}{l}2 \text { : integrand } \\ 1: \text { limits } \\ 1: \text { answer }\end{array}\right.\)
\item[] \(3:\left\{\begin{array}{l}2: \text { integrand } \\ 1: \text { answer }\end{array}\right.\)
\item[] \(2:\left\{\begin{array}{l}1: \text { area of one region } \\ 1: \text { equation }\end{array}\right.\)
\end{itemize}
